verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Slack's app-building stack (Bolt SDK starter templates, chat.postMessage API, Events API, CLI, developer sandboxes, workflow branching, canvas creation) which are the building blocks for rich in-chat apps, but the pack never explicitly names Block Kit, modals, buttons, or structured interactive message layouts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Block Kit UI components, modal/dialog surfaces, interactive button/select elements, and hands-on examples of building rich chat UI beyond plain messages/canvases.
